data.text:
R.Velavan vs Dr.M.Jagadish Chandra Bose on 24 July, 2024 
Author: G.K.Ilanthiraiyan
Bench: G.K.Ilanthiraiyan
 Cont.P.N
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras
 Dated : 24.07.2024
 Coram
 The Honourable Mr. Justice G.K.Ilanthiraiyan
 Cont.P.No.1914 of 2024
 R.Velavan ... Petitio
 Vs.
 Dr.M.Jagadish Chandra Bose,
 Designated Officer,
 Food Safety Department,
 Ii Floor, Collectorate Main Complex,
 Thiruvallur District. ... Respond
 Prayer:- Contempt petition has been filed under Section 11 of the Co
 of Courts Act, 1971, praying to punish the respondent herein for the
 disobedience in not implementing the order made in W.M.P.No.15132 of
 2024 in W.P.No.13938 of 2024 dated 22.05.2024. 
 For Petitioner : Mr.R.S.Anandan
 For Respondent : Mr.P.Kumaresan
 Additional Advocate General
 Assisted by Mr.K.Tippu Sult
 Government Advocate
 Page 1 of 4
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

 Cont
 Order
This Contempt Petition has been filed to punish the respondent for non compliance of the order R.Velavan vs Dr.M.Jagadish Chandra Bose on 24 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32339187/
1 dated 22.05.2024 passed by this Court in W.M.P.No.15132 of 2024 in W.P.No.13938 of 2024,
thereby granted an order of interim stay of recovery. 
2. The learned Additional Advocate General appearing for the respondent submitted that the scale of pay of the petitioner has been revised and he was granted revised scale of pay. 
3. It is seen that this Court granted interim stay of recovery alone. 
The revision of pay scale is nothing to do with the order passed by this Court on 22.05.2024. 
Therefore, no contempt is made out as against the respondent and the present petition is liable to be dismissed. Accordingly, the Contempt Petition stands dismissed.
